title: Daon’s Conor White on Where a Passkey Stops Being the Defence
summary:

The post Daon’s Conor White on Where a Passkey Stops Being the Defence appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: Conor White of Daon discusses the limitations of passkeys in cybersecurity. While phishing resistance protects the credential itself, regulated firms must implement additional identity verification layers around passkeys to ensure robust security and maintain compliance standards across their digital platforms.
